entries.071a7709cb3b2755: Its customers are pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas to which it licenses out development, manufacturing and sales rights for the drug candidates it has developed. The counterparty to which it recorded revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was Nihon Baiosera-pi Kenkyujo Co., Ltd., a patent licensee.
entries.0e0a6be8168d68d6: Pharmaceutical companies (out-licensing counterparties for development, manufacturing and marketing rights)
entries.12fbc72d4fab2014: The net loss for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,304 million, widening from ¥1,151 million in the previous fiscal year. The company has no approved products yet and remains in a stage of continued upfront investment in research and development.
entries.348b964277279479: Up-front payment income from patent license grants
entries.3c5ed3b4641092c5: The company states that it holds exclusive worldwide rights to develop, manufacture and sell under patents for iPS cell-derived NKT cells acquired from National Research and Development Agency RIKEN; that it has licensed in STAR-CRISPR gene editing technology; and that it possesses HER2 CAR-T cell therapy technology based on a cell culture method co-developed with National University Corporation Shinshu University.
entries.4858f44ddc66dc94: Under 'Business Overview,' the filing states that the product is a CAR-T cell drug that uses allogeneic iPS cell-derived NKT cells made from healthy donors in place of the patient's own T cells used in approved autologous CAR-T cell therapies, which makes advance production and stocking possible.
entries.4eebb4560e2c80f4: Sales royalty income after market launch
entries.51291b8fbd179a3e: A single-segment business focused on developing new cancer immunotherapy drugs. Originating from research on cancer peptide vaccines, the business currently develops multiple pipeline candidates from exploratory research to early clinical trial stages, centered on iPS cell-derived cell therapies and antibody drugs. Developed drug candidates are licensed out to pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas, and the model generates licensing income. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥84 thousand.
entries.65e1c0ad678ad3b5: It concentrates resources on development from exploratory research through early-stage clinical trials and advances multiple pipelines in parallel, thereby continuously creating licensing-out opportunities.
entries.67acfd73f2b35750: A single-segment business focused on developing new cancer immunotherapy drugs.
entries.6e10edd8110fc4a4: Under 'Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Be Addressed,' the filing states that the company will focus its development area on cancer immunotherapy drugs, pursue open innovation, and aim for sustainable development and corporate growth through a virtuous cycle from its licensing-out business model. The filing also states, under 'Business Overview,' that pipelines at various development stages are being developed in parallel.
entries.6f67d0aceed37250: A feature is that iPS cell-derived NKT cells from allogeneic donors, made from healthy donors, can be produced in advance and kept in stock, enabling a supply model different from autologous CAR-T cell therapies that use the patient's own cells.
entries.7349adbddc7190b7: It is an early-stage drug discovery venture with no approved products yet, and all of its pipelines are at stages from exploratory research to early-stage clinical trials.
entries.79636d374d44ecf4: Under 'Business Overview,' the filing states that the company is a drug discovery venture with multiple pipelines at stages from exploratory research to early-stage clinical trials.
entries.866e5d9a5b9753dd: Up-front payment income on signing license agreements
entries.903a648ddaf4d70b: As antibody drugs that bind to immune checkpoint molecules and immunoregulatory molecules that suppress immune function in tumor tissue and inhibit their function, the company is developing BP1212, an anti-CD39 × anti-TIM-3 bispecific antibody, and BP1223, a T cell engager targeting CD39 and CD3.
entries.a5bc14a182d80dc3: The company states that cancer immunotherapy is an area driving growth in the global pharmaceutical market more than any other drug category, and that it leaves ample room to meet unmet medical needs where conventional treatments have failed to achieve therapeutic effects.
entries.b5a4dade1cc38323: BP2201 (iPS cell-derived regenerative NKT cell therapy)
entries.be3ebccbf7764e91: The company is developing BP2201, a regenerative NKT cell therapy using iPS cell-derived NKT cells, BP2202, a BCMA CAR-NKT cell therapy targeting multiple myeloma, and BP2301, a CAR-T cell therapy targeting HER2.
entries.cb917a46a1104fb5: The company states that it aims for sustainable development and corporate growth through a business model that focuses its development area on cancer immunotherapy drugs, pursues open innovation with a wide range of academic institutions and ventures in Japan and overseas, concentrates on creating seeds and demonstrating drug concepts, and, from late-stage clinical trials onward (which require large-scale organizational structures), licenses out to pharmaceutical companies with manufacturing and sales networks to achieve early monetization.
entries.d749b8003dd3d4b5: BP2202 (iPS cell-derived BCMA CAR-NKT cell therapy)
entries.dd4de6dc0583f0e7: The company specializes in developing cancer immunotherapy drugs, advancing from exploratory research through early-stage clinical trials a pipeline that includes cell therapies using iPS cell-derived NKT cells (BP2201 and BP2202), a HER2-targeting CAR-T cell therapy (BP2301), and antibody drugs targeting immune checkpoint molecules and others (BP1212 and BP1223).
entries.e4bfbb55ccb04895: Pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas (licensees of development, manufacturing and sales rights)
entries.e6e4264228adba0f: It earns revenue from up-front payments on signing license agreements, milestones tied to development progress, and sales royalties after market launch. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥84 thousand, consisting of up-front payment income from a patent license grant. Revenue decreased from ¥1,133 thousand in the previous fiscal year, when up-front payment income from licensing held patents had been recorded.
entries.e757692540fe3208: Founded in 2003 in Kurume, Fukuoka Prefecture, as a drug discovery venture, the company is now headquartered in Kawasaki, Kanagawa Prefecture, and listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of March 31, 2026, the company had 23 employees.
entries.e7be57fe1a2690f0: The company is developing BP2201, a regenerative NKT cell therapy using iPS cell-derived NKT cells, BP2202, a BCMA CAR-NKT cell therapy targeting multiple myeloma, and BP2301, a CAR-T cell therapy targeting HER2. The company plans to conduct clinical trials in the United States for BP2202 from fiscal 2026.
entries.fc8852d567f12770: A drug discovery venture that creates and develops novel cancer immunotherapy drugs in-house and earns revenue by licensing out results up to early-stage clinical trials to pharmaceutical companies.
entries.fff5a4ff6fe851ef: The business model involves creating or acquiring cancer immunotherapy drug seeds, handling everything from exploratory research through early-stage clinical trials, licensing out development, manufacturing and sales rights to pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas, and earning up-front payments, development milestones and sales royalties.
